# Yasvik Foods

Yasvik Foods is an organic food shop and neighborhood grocery in Ashok Nagar, Chanda Nagar (Serilingampally), Hyderabad, Telangana, India.

Canonical website: https://www.yasvik.com/
Store page: https://www.yasvik.com/store
Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/sKdPkSmNvqmrUC2a7
Phone / WhatsApp: +91 78429 38998
Email: yasvikfoods@gmail.com

## What Yasvik is
- Brand: Yasvik / Yasvik Foods
- Tagline: Better Food. Found.
- Type: Organic Food Shop · Indian grocery · walk-in store with local Hyderabad delivery
- Location: Bavanipuram Colony Road no 4, Ashok Nagar, Chanda Nagar, Hyderabad 500050
- Service areas: Chanda Nagar, Lingampally, Ameenpur, Nallagandla, Serilingampally, and wider Hyderabad
- Hours: typically open daily (confirm on Google Business Profile / website)

## Core offerings (sell online and in store)
- Cold-pressed / wood-pressed oils (groundnut, sesame and related cooking oils)
- Millets and millet foods (including ragi flour and related staples)
- Heritage and everyday rice (including sonamasoori and handpound varieties when available)
- Dals, pulses and pantry staples
- Homemade pickles (including Andhra styles such as avakaya when available)
- Homemade snacks, spice powders and podis
- Pure ghee, honey, jaggery
- Dry fruits, nuts and seeds
- Pooja essentials (camphor, dhoop and related items when available)
- Natural care items (e.g. bamboo brushes, natural soaps) when available
